why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither one shows up. (1) The builder brief has the builder catch the parse error in loadConfig, but only to throw again: "Rethrow an error whose `message` contains..." and "Keep the thrown error a `SyntaxError`". It also says outright: "Do not make `loadConfig` swallow the error or return `{}`/defaults." Nothing in it tells the builder to return a value. (2) For line 2, verifier Check 2 passes any stderr with "a location giving line 3 and column 3, e.g. `line 3 column 3` or `3:3`". The formats are only examples, so it doesn't require one exact wording or order. The exact-string check applies only to the path `<D>/c.json`, which the issue requires anyway. Its FAIL conditions cover only missing parts, a changed path or a wrong location, not a different format.
